title: 'Drink water': Ronaldo removes Coca-Cola bottles in press conference
summary: A one-minute Telegraph news clip of Cristiano Ronaldo moving two Coca-Cola bottles aside at a Euro 2020 press conference and saying 'Drink water.' The moment went viral and drew praise from anti-obesity campaigners.
why: Cited in threads about sugary drinks, alcohol and advertising as a famous example of a star publicly rejecting a sponsor's product.

quote.text: Ronaldo's Coke/water moment gave me a vast amount of respect for him
